about_the_game:
The difference between "ReMix:Encore" and the official version
Characters: 3 heroes and 2 scenes in Encore, 7 heroes and more battle scenes in the official version
Difficulty: Encore can only challenge 2 difficulties. In the official version, each hero has 6 difficulties to challenge.
Music library: Encore’s random music library contains 7 additional tracks, and the official version has 20+ additional tracks, and is continuously updated and added



A new hero - The Undertaker is here.
The Undertaker can assist in combat by summoning and controlling monsters' spirits.


Continuously hitting the beat can accumulate legato levels, the music will become richer, and stronger performance of the character will be activated.
New mode - random music library mode
Turn on the random music library mode and use any hero to randomly play more than 20 new songs. Feel the different fighting rhythm!
Custom tracks
Players can import their favorite tracks into the game folder, switch to "Custom Tracks" mode in the game, and then play with customized music.



Different heroes, different rhythms.
Different heroes will bring different music and rhythms.
The effects of skills vary for different rhythms.

  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 580 / AMD HD 7870
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: GTX 680 / AMD HD 7970
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM

short_description: a unique musical rhythm action game that combines the elements of Rogue games. In this world, you are able to choose from a variety of heroes with different fighting styles and use the power of music to battle against evil void monsters.
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Spanish - Latin America, Korean
